# TLS handshake failures between two internal services

Service A cannot call Service B after a security hardening change; external traffic is unaffected.

A hardening change disabled TLS 1.2 on Service B, but Service A's client library was pinned to TLS 1.2, so the two could not negotiate a common protocol.

1. Capture the handshake_failure and confirm the protocol mismatch
2. Enable TLS 1.3 in Service A's client (or temporarily re-allow 1.2 on B)
3. Roll out and confirm mTLS handshakes succeed
4. Coordinate protocol-deprecation changes across dependent services

Error Details
```
TLS handshake failed: alert handshake_failure (40); 'no cipher suites in common'; Service B now requires TLS 1.3 only, Service A pinned to TLS 1.2
```

Tags: security, tls-handshake, handshake-failure-40, tls-version, mtls
